t: For expenses necessary for basic and applied scientific research, development, test and evaluation, including maintenance, rehabilitation, lease, and operation of facilities and equipment, $11,054,958,000, to remain available for obligation until September 30, 2008.

fable.w: This is a pure appropriations provision that makes funds available for research, development, test and evaluation through a set date. There is no tempting reading here: it names no outside party, and no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation, rulemaking, or right to sue. Nothing crosses the federal boundary into a government decision.
fable.s: For expenses necessary for basic and applied scientific research, development, test and evaluation
